description: Four hooks, all ON by default with a documented opt-out. SessionStart (compact|resume|clear|startup): control-anchor re-injection (compaction-survival); opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_ANCHOR_HOOKS=0. SessionStart (resume|compact): the stale skill-body check, read from the session transcript; one line per plugin whose last-served skill body came from an older cached version than the installed one, naming both versions and the fix; silent when every body is current or served from outside a plugin cache. Opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_STALE_BODY_CHECK=0. PostToolUse (Write|Edit|MultiEdit): a size warning when a write to an open anchor leaves its HEAD over the injection budget or within 10% of it, plus the self-ignoring .gitignore in the anchors directory; silent on every other write; it shares the SESSION_WORKFLOW_ANCHOR_HOOKS=0 opt-out. Stop: the feedback-debt nudge, read from the session transcript; it stays silent unless a feedback-targets file resolves, so an install with no registered tools never sees it. Opt out with SESSION_WORKFLOW_FEEDBACK_NUDGE=0. Every no-op path returns zero with no output. See the plugin README for the exact settings block each opt-out goes in.
